repos_data.description: Open-source local AI audio & music studio for macOS & Windows. TTS, voice cloning, songs with lyrics, and multi-track scores — 100% offline, zero API fees.

AI-powered FL Studio control via the Model Context Protocol. Beyond piano-roll notes — full in-DAW mixing (Mix Doctor, gain staging, EQ/comp/reverb, reference matching), routing, and composition through Claude and other MCP clients. 67 tools. Windows & macOS.
MCP server for Suno AI music generation, lyrics, and cover workflows via Ace Data Cloud.
Audio mastering for AI agents via MCP: LUFS/True Peak targets, album mode, 24-s preset previews, Suno/Udio AI-trace cleanup. Hosted at https://magicmaster.pro/mcp
